race.comment: BOLE LE (5) is a consistent conveyance who has hit the top-four at his past nine outings and doesn't know how to run a bad race. Has placed two of four over this mile journey and strips fitter third-up from the break. Goes on top. FORTY TIMES (3) boasts a win over this track and trip and gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim. Looms as the main danger. CLEARLY GEORGE (7) hasn't been too far away in recent efforts and is a genuine top-three contender on best figures. In the mix. MADALSA (1) is a four-time winner here on her home track and looks a must for the exotics players. LORD PROTECTOR (13) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be underestimated.
